title: Recommended by my former manager for leadership and DORA gains
summary: My former manager, head of worldwide Software Excellence, called me a natural leader who inspires people regardless of reporting lines, and credited my work with significant DORA improvements.
what_would_have_happened: Not applicable: a role or recognition event, not an intervention.
the_call: Lead by example across reporting lines and team boundaries.
what_i_did: Led initiatives that, in his words, improved the team's performance and morale, and coached peers on craftsmanship, testing and CI/CD.
what_changed: A public, named recommendation that cites DORA improvements for both traditional software and SaaS projects.

quotes.text: His efforts have led to significant improvements in our DORA metrics for both traditional software and SaaS projects.
quotes.role: Former head of worldwide Software Excellence
